body:
> This PR also removes the `UNSIGNED_INDEX` macros because they're no longer necessary & updates certain macro instances to not need conversion casts where unnecessary.

See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/96356#issuecomment-2322795570 on why we should keep those macros.
Same as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/96356#issuecomment-2532875167, this really needs to be benchmarked before making the codebase slower for a minor gain in API usability.

> Same as [#96356 (comment)](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/96356#issuecomment-2532875167), this really needs to be benchmarked before making the codebase slower for a minor gain in API usability.

Most of the checks are compile-time, so it shouldn't really impact performance, IMHO.

> for a minor gain in API usability.

I don't agree. I think these PRs are making sure that the codebase is handling type conversion properly. Casting a `int` to a `uint` can have unforseen consequences when negative, and there's currently no checks about that. Technically, we should have a macro for each combination to properly check.

> > for a minor gain in API usability.
> 
> I don't agree. I think these PRs are making sure that the codebase is handling type conversion properly. Casting a `int` to a `uint` can have unforseen consequences when negative, and there's currently no checks about that. Technically, we should have a macro for each combination to properly check.

This is a good opportunity to review the best practices guide in the docs. Especially: [To solve the problem, it has to exist in the first place](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/development/best_practices_for_engine_contributors.html#to-solve-the-problem-it-has-to-exist-in-the-first-place). This is a clear example of a solution in search of a problem. Neither this, https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/96356, or https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/96302 link to a bug report or describe a real bug in the codebase that is being solved.

> This is a clear example of a solution in search of a problem.

I don't agree. I stumbled enough times onto this problem. I struggled once on what to do when you don't have matching types to compare. It delegates the burden of figuring it out to the individual developer when there's an objective way to do it: letting the compiler decide.

~~I'll create an issue for this then.~~

I forgot to add that I originally sought to consolidate index error macro logic because we push people to convert internal `Vector<>` use to use instead `LocalVector<>` for performance reasons.

And one detail that prevents just replacing `Vector` to `LocalVector` is that the latter uses unsigned ints for `size()`, and the former uses signed ints. And this messes up comparisons hard.

This PR would just make existing code work, easing up tedious conversions.
